verdict.rationale: CrewAI's crew/task/process model (sequential or hierarchical) and Flows allow chaining multiple tasks/agents, and a real-world HN example shows a crew processing many emails (categorizing, labeling, deleting) via tool calls, suggesting it can act across many items in a workflow. However, there is no documented 'bulk operation' primitive (e.g., batch kickoff over a list of items, bulk API endpoint) — the kickoff API starts a single crew execution rather than an explicit multi-item batch. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch execution API or documented pattern for applying one task across N items in parallel, and independent verification of scale/performance at bulk volume.
